"""One user-requested extra repair through existing AA1 pipeline phases."""
import json
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'AA1'))
from auto_adapter import orchestrator as o

rid = 'unitree_a1'
model = 'eu.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8'
base = o.REPO_ROOT / 'autoadapter_bench/diagnostics/capability_update_20260909'
source = base / 'stage1_full_opus48_20260910T142842Z/repair_3/unitree_a1'
stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
root = base / ('unitree_a1_extra_repair_opus48_' + stamp)
root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
Path('/private/tmp/aa1_unitree_a1_extra_repair_path').write_text(str(root))
summary_path = root / 'summary_unitree_a1.json'
started = time.time()
summary = {'robot_id': rid, 'model': model, 'provider': 'holistic',
    'scope': 'User-authorized extra diagnostic after the original three-repair budget; not a replacement of the original result',
    'original_max_repairs': 3, 'additional_repairs_allowed': 1,
    'source_candidate': o._stage1_pointer(source / 'driver.py'),
    'source_report': o._stage1_pointer(source / 'validate_report.json'),
    'started_at': o._stage1_utc_now(), 'finished_at': None,
    'git_commit': o._stage1_git_commit(), 'generation_ok': False,
    'framework_ok': False, 'stage1_ok': False, 'actual_cost_usd': None,
    'summary_path': o._stage1_pointer(summary_path)}
o._stage1_write_json(summary_path, summary)
print('RUN_ROOT', root, flush=True)
try:
    definition = o._stage1_canonical_definition(rid)
    mjcf = o._stage1_canonical_mjcf(definition)
    runner = o._stage1_standard_runner(rid, mjcf, root / 'repair_4', model)
    w = runner.workspace
    copied = o._stage1_copy_candidate(source, w, 'skeleton')
    feedback = o.validate_failure_feedback(json.loads((source / 'validate_report.json').read_text()))
    o._stage1_write_json(w / 'feedback_input.json', {'feedback': feedback})
    context = o._stage1_round_context(w, robot_id=rid, model=model, route='skeleton', attempt=4,
        max_repairs=4, started_at=summary['started_at'], git_commit=summary['git_commit'])
    context.update({'original_max_repairs': 3, 'additional_repairs_allowed': 1,
        'scope': summary['scope'], 'source_candidate': summary['source_candidate'],
        'fresh_study_or_generate': False, 'invocation_source': Path(__file__).read_text()})
    o._stage1_write_json(w / 'run_context.json', context)
    print('REPAIR_STARTED', flush=True)
    generation = o._stage1_run_phase(runner, '03_repair_4', lambda: runner._phase_repair(feedback, 4), ('driver.py',))
    context['generation'] = o._stage1_phase_payload(generation)
    o._stage1_write_json(w / 'run_context.json', context)
    external = o._stage1_transport_error(generation)
    summary.update({'generation': context['generation'], 'external_blocked': external,
        'generation_ok': bool(generation.ok and (w / 'driver.py').is_file() and not external),
        'total_tokens': generation.token_usage, 'generation_duration_sec': generation.duration_sec,
        'workspace': o._stage1_pointer(w), 'final_candidate': o._stage1_pointer(w / 'driver.py')})
    o._stage1_write_json(summary_path, summary)
    print('REPAIR_FINISHED', json.dumps({'generation_ok': summary['generation_ok'], 'external_blocked': external}), flush=True)
    if external:
        summary['error'] = generation.error
    else:
        print('FRAMEWORK_STARTED', flush=True)
        report, info = o._stage1_framework_subprocess(robot_id=rid, workspace=w,
            definition=definition, route='skeleton', mjcf_path=mjcf, model=model)
        ok = bool(info.get('child_ok')) and o._stage1_framework_ok(report, rid, definition, 'skeleton')
        context.update({'framework_subprocess': info, 'validate_report': o._stage1_pointer(w / 'validate_report.json')})
        summary.update({'framework_ok': ok, 'stage1_ok': bool(summary['generation_ok'] and ok),
            'framework_report': context['validate_report'], 'framework_subprocess': info,
            'physics_duration_sec': o._stage1_physics_seconds(report),
            'conditions': [{'case_id': t.get('case_id', t.get('test')), 'ok': t.get('ok'),
                'detail': t.get('detail'), 'trace_path': t.get('trace_path'), 'video_path': t.get('video_path')}
                for t in report.get('tests', [])],
            'error': None if ok else report.get('error', 'Framework validation failed')})
    context['finished_at'] = o._stage1_utc_now()
    o._stage1_write_json(w / 'run_context.json', context)
except BaseException as exc:
    summary.update({'error': f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}', 'external_blocked': o._stage1_external_exception(exc)})
    raise
finally:
    summary.update({'finished_at': o._stage1_utc_now(), 'total_duration_sec': time.time() - started})
    o._stage1_write_json(summary_path, summary)
    print('SUMMARY', json.dumps({k: summary.get(k) for k in ['summary_path', 'generation_ok', 'framework_ok', 'stage1_ok', 'external_blocked', 'error', 'total_duration_sec']}), flush=True)
